experiences.name: Meia Praia Beach Day
experiences.description: Spend a relaxed afternoon at Meia Praia, one of the longest and most accessible beaches in the Algarve, located just minutes from Lagos town center. Ideal for a late Day 1 arrival — simply drop bags at a Lagos-based hotel and walk to the beach. Calm waters, golden sand, and beachside bars make it perfect for unwinding after a long flight without needing transport.

experiences.name: Praia da Marinha Coastal Walk and Swim
experiences.description: Explore the iconic sea caves, rock arches, and crystal-clear waters of Praia da Marinha via a scenic clifftop trail. Stay in Carvoeiro or Lagoa to be within 10 minutes of this beach, avoiding long transfers. Best visited in the morning before crowds arrive. No boat required — the beach and caves are accessible on foot from the clifftop path.

experiences.name: Algarve Wine Tasting at Quinta dos Vales
experiences.description: Visit one of the Algarve's most celebrated wineries, Quinta dos Vales, for a guided tour of the vineyards and a tasting of regional wines including Negra Mole and Syrah blends. Located near Estômbar, it is easily reachable from Lagoa or Silves — both excellent hotel hubs. Book a morning session to pair with a light lunch on-site and make the most of the day.

experiences.name: Silves Castle and Old Town Wine Trail
experiences.description: Explore the medieval Moorish castle of Silves and wander the historic old town, stopping at local wine bars and shops to taste Algarve regional wines and local medronho brandy. Silves is a central hub with affordable accommodation, putting you close to both inland wine country and coastal beaches. Combine culture and wine tasting in one half-day outing.

experiences.name: Benagil Sea Cave Kayak Tour
experiences.description: Paddle by kayak from Benagil Beach into the famous Benagil Cave, one of the most photographed natural wonders in Portugal. Departing from Benagil itself, this tour requires no long transfers — stay in Carvoeiro (5 minutes away) to maximize convenience. Morning departures offer calmer seas and better light inside the cave. A guided 2-hour kayak tour includes safety equipment and a local expert.
